title: Merch Object Studies
description: Five independent studies of merch-drop surfaces such as tote mockups, sticker packs, package inserts, display boards, and bundled object flat lays.
creative_direction: Independent assets should feel like genuine tour commerce surfaces: collector-grade objects, tactile materials, controlled graphics, and launch-week presentation without readable pricing or branding.
